title: Probability-weighted inner product
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability mass function $\pi$ on $\Omega$, and real-valued functions $f,g$ on $\Omega$, define their probability-weighted inner product to be $\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}[f(x)g(x)]$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
